_meta.source: FAOSTAT Detailed Trade Matrix (TM), bulk normalized download: https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/Trade_DetailedTradeMatrix_E_All_Data_(Normalized).zip
_meta.notes: Corridor tonnes = importer-reported import quantity (FAO element 5610); where the importer did not report, the exporter-reported export quantity (5910) to it, flagged basis='mirror'. Items summed on a product-weight basis per commodity. Year = latest with a reported world total >= 85% of the year before. Top 300 corridors kept per commodity; shares are of the importer's total and of world trade. Bulk file last modified 2026-09-26.

rice.label: Rice
rice.basis: husked, milled and broken rice, product weight

dairy.label: Dairy
dairy.basis: butter, cheese, milk and whey powders, product weight

vegetables.label: Vegetables
vegetables.basis: tomatoes, onions and other fresh vegetables
